fusions.name: Leveller
fusions.desc: A flattening blow that deals 40 damage, ignores armour, leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Toll
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 18 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Smith's Summons
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 25% for 10 seconds and pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Finishing Weight
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 6%.
